Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. With stylish layouts and carefully planned living spaces, each residence creates a welcoming environment for individuals, couples, and families seeking a contemporary home in Dubai. The development offers a range of lifestyle amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and recreation. Residents can enjoy a lagoon-inspired swimming pool, infinity pool, fully equipped fitness centre, jogging track, poolside cabanas, and landscaped outdoor spaces. Dedicated leisure and relaxation areas create opportunities to unwind, enjoy outdoor activities, and experience a resort-style atmosphere within the residential community. Mirari Lagoon combines modern residential comfort with a leisure-focused lifestyle, creating an environment where everyday living is complemented by recreational facilities and thoughtfully designed surroundings. Its fully furnished apartments, contemporary design, and selection of lifestyle amenities make the development an appealing choice for both homeowners and investors looking for a modern residential property in Dubai. With its location in Dubai Industrial City, Mirari Lagoon offers connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai are approximately 10 minutes away, while Palm Jebel Ali is around 20 minutes away. Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai are also accessible by road, offering residents convenient access to shopping, entertainment, business, and leisure destinations. The project features studio apartments starting from approximately AED 565,000, 1-bedroom apartments from AED 899,000, and 2-bedroom apartments from AED 1,127,000. Buyers can benefit from an advertised flexible payment plan of 20% on booking, 28% during construction, 10% on handover, and 42% post-handover over 60 months. With its fully furnished residences, resort-inspired amenities, and flexible payment structure, Mirari Lagoon presents an attractive opportunity for those looking to own a home or explore property investment in Dubai. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Industrial City is an established industrial and commercial destination within the wider Dubai South region, offering connectivity to important transport, logistics, and business hubs. Its strategic position makes it an emerging location for residential developments, particularly for professionals and residents seeking convenient access to employment and infrastructure. The surrounding area benefits from its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, and major road networks connecting different parts of the emirate. These destinations contribute to the area's long-term development potential and accessibility. Residents can also reach shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday facilities across nearby communities. With its growing infrastructure, strategic connectivity, and proximity to major development zones in southern Dubai, Dubai Industrial City offers an interesting residential and investment location. Mirari Lagoon brings together modern furnished apartments, leisure facilities, and convenient access to key destinations, creating a contemporary living option within this developing part of Dubai.

Its residential collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximise functionality, natural light, and everyday comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary layouts create bright, inviting interiors suited to both homeowners and property investors. Amenities and lifestyle Designed to bring resort-inspired living into an urban setting, Azizi Milan offers an extensive selection of more than 30 amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and dedicated children's play areas, alongside convenient retail outlets and dining options within the community. One of the development's standout features is its expansive crystal-clear lagoon, creating a striking waterfront atmosphere and adding a leisure-focused dimension to everyday living. Combined with recreational facilities and community spaces, these amenities offer opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and social connection. Finishes and interiors The residences feature modern interiors, quality materials, and practical layouts that balance contemporary style with functionality. Large windows allow natural light to fill the living spaces, while the clean, modern aesthetic provides a versatile foundation for personalisation. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens designed to provide everyday convenience and functionality. Furnishing Unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located in City of Arabia within Dubailand, Azizi Milan is part of a planned mixed-use destination designed to bring residential living, retail, entertainment, and leisure together. The wider area is envisioned as a vibrant urban community with a diverse range of residential options and lifestyle facilities. City of Arabia is associated with major planned attractions, including Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet theme park concept. As development progresses, the wider district aims to offer a blend of shopping, dining, family entertainment, and recreational spaces within a connected community environment. Dubailand provides access to several established residential neighbourhoods and leisure destinations across Dubai. Road connections link the area with other parts of the city, making it a location to consider for residents seeking a contemporary home away from the busiest central districts. Combining Italian-inspired design, a broad range of amenities, and a lagoon-centred lifestyle, Azizi Milan offers a distinctive residential concept for buyers looking for modern living and potential investment opportunities in Dubailand.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. From cascading water features to outdoor cinema and relaxation decks, every space is designed to evoke a refined island retreat atmosphere. The residences are delivered fully furnished and fully designed, incorporating a smart home system and refined interior detailing accessorized by Hermès. Layouts are bright and airy, emphasizing natural light and a smooth transition between interior and exterior spaces. Duplex residences feature elevated privacy and, in select units, private pools, enhancing the exclusive waterfront experience. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz represents a harmonious blend of architectural elegance, intelligent living, and curated luxury in a serene island setting. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities. title: V45M+HG, Dubai
description: Golf Trails by Emaar Properties is a contemporary residential development located within the prestigious Emaar South community in Dubai. Inspired by the natural beauty of its surroundings, the development features elegant modern architecture that blends seamlessly with the lush landscapes of the Emaar South Golf Course. Offering a selection of thoughtfully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, Golf Trails combines spacious layouts, refined interiors, and a peaceful residential setting to create an ideal living environment for individuals and families. The architectural design reflects a sophisticated balance between contemporary aesthetics and natural elements, with earthy tones and elegant detailing that complement the surrounding greenery. Designed to promote an active yet relaxed lifestyle, the development offers an extensive range of amenities, including an infinity swimming pool, children's swimming pool, sports courts, landscaped open lawns, and a fully equipped fitness center. Residents can also enjoy dedicated children's play areas, multipurpose spaces, and beautifully designed outdoor leisure areas, creating opportunities for recreation, relaxation, and community engagement. The interiors are thoughtfully crafted with high-quality materials, contemporary finishes, and a warm, neutral colour palette that creates a calming and welcoming atmosphere. Open-plan layouts maximize space and natural light, while modern kitchens feature stylish fittings and contemporary appliances. Luxuriously finished bathrooms, carefully selected materials, and elegant detailing further enhance the overall residential experience. Every element is designed to provide comfort, functionality, and timeless appeal. Location Description & Benefits Located within Emaar South, Golf Trails enjoys a strategic position in one of Dubai's emerging residential and golf communities. Emaar South is a master-planned development designed around modern living, landscaped green spaces, and an integrated community lifestyle. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport and major economic hubs makes it an attractive destination for residents seeking connectivity, convenience, and long-term growth potential. The community benefits from convenient access to major destinations, including Expo City Dubai, Dubai South, and Dubai Marina, while its connectivity to key road networks allows residents to travel efficiently across Dubai and the wider UAE. The nearby Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club further enhances the area's recreational appeal, offering additional leisure and sporting experiences. One of the community's most distinctive features is the Emaar South Golf Course, which provides a picturesque green backdrop and an exceptional lifestyle experience for golf enthusiasts. Residents can enjoy beautifully landscaped surroundings, outdoor recreational spaces, and a peaceful atmosphere away from the city's busy urban environment. Emaar South is designed as a self-sufficient residential community, offering a comprehensive range of everyday facilities, including community parks, retail outlets, dining options, educational facilities, and a mosque. The planned school district and family-oriented amenities make it particularly appealing to families seeking a convenient and well-connected residential environment. With its golf-course surroundings, contemporary residences, extensive lifestyle amenities, and strategic location near Dubai's expanding southern growth corridor, Golf Trails presents an attractive opportunity for both end-users and investors looking for quality living and future potential in Dubai.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Project general facts This is a thoughtfully designed boutique residential address in one of Dubai's most promising green communities. This modern sanctuary blends contemporary architecture with refined detailing, offering a collection of spacious one-and-a-half and two-and-a-half bedroom residences. Crafted for families and individuals who value both calm and connection, Blossom 40 provides elegant homes with purposeful layouts and a calm presence, where life is always in full bloom. Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated rooftop retreat where wellness, leisure, and play come together. Amenities include a temperature-controlled infinity pool with a serene double-height space, a modern gymnasium for focused workouts, a recreation space, a kids' play zone, and a dedicated pet play zone. The rooftop is designed as a balanced escape above the city, offering energizing workouts, relaxed social spaces, and open-air recreation for families and pets. Every home is finished with premium materials and thoughtful details. Spacious layouts feature light-filled interiors, expansive living areas, sleek kitchens, and serene bedrooms. The design blends minimalist luxury with everyday ease, creating homes that are as practical as they are beautiful. From the entrance lobby to the rooftop gym, every space reflects quiet elegance, offering warmth, comfort, and refined style. Location description and benefits Nestled in Majan, one of Dubai's most promising green communities, this exceptional location offers residents the rare luxury of living next to Al Barari, Dubai's greenest neighborhood, where the majority of the masterplan is dedicated to lush gardens, lakes, and thousands of trees. This proximity makes the air fresher, the mornings brighter, and the evenings calmer, creating a true urban forest in the desert. The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and family-friendly environment. Direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road places Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport within easy reach, while nearby attractions include IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, and Miracle Garden. Everyday conveniences such as supermarkets, international schools, and healthcare facilities are all just around the corner. For those seeking a residence that embodies tranquility, nature, and strong investment potential, Majan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of lush green surroundings, masterplanned infrastructure, and a well-connected address makes it one of Dubai's most desirable locations. title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: This residence located on Dubai Island, combines modern style with comfort and elegance. From spacious one-bedroom to three-bedroom homes, each residence offers quality furnishings, generous spaces, and private pools. Designed for peaceful and comfortable living, it offers a refined lifestyle that feels both luxurious and welcoming. Dubai Islands Highlights: - Modern Waterfront Living Dubai Islands is a beautiful waterfront destination made up of five connected islands. It offers a mix of peaceful beaches, green parks, walking areas, and modern homes. With more than 60 km of waterfront and over 20 km of beaches, residents can enjoy plenty of space by the sea. The area also includes a Blue Flag-certified beach, large parks, and golf courses with views of the Arabian Gulf. Dubai Islands master plan features two planned golf courses, including an 18-hole championship course and a 9-hole course, prominently featured on designated areas like Golf Island (Island D) and Oasis Island (Island C). LIVING SPACES: Open layouts, textured materials, and refined details create an atmosphere of effortless elegance. From expansive residences to the Signature Sky Lofts with their double-height ceilings and natural flow, every home celebrates craftsmanship and calm. description: Shoreline is a contemporary residential development designed to bring the comfort of private living together with the indulgence of a resort-inspired lifestyle. Drawing inspiration from the natural movement of water and the sculptural beauty of sand dunes, the development embraces an architectural concept that blends modern design with organic forms. Its thoughtful layouts and nature-inspired aesthetic create a tranquil residential environment where sophistication, comfort, and relaxation come together. Amenities and lifestyle Shoreline is designed around the principles of wellness, leisure, and everyday tranquillity. Carefully planned communal spaces and landscaped surroundings create a welcoming atmosphere, while thoughtfully integrated recreational facilities enhance the resort-style experience. The development's water-inspired design concept flows throughout its shared spaces, creating a sense of calm and exclusivity. With an emphasis on relaxation and contemporary convenience, Shoreline offers a lifestyle that allows residents to enjoy a holiday-inspired atmosphere within their own residential community. Interiors and finishes The residences feature contemporary interiors complemented by high-quality materials and modern finishes. Soft forms, elegant detailing, and a carefully coordinated colour palette reflect the development's nature-inspired architectural concept, creating inviting spaces that balance style with functionality. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens with appliances, offering everyday convenience and practical functionality. Furnishing Unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their living spaces according to their individual tastes and lifestyle preferences. Location and lifestyle Situated on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, Shoreline enjoys a coastal setting known for its beaches, waterfront communities, and growing collection of hospitality and leisure destinations. The island's distinctive landscape and seaside atmosphere create an appealing environment for those seeking a more relaxed pace of living away from the bustle of Dubai. A major attraction in the surrounding area is the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort, an anticipated landmark expected to strengthen Ras Al Khaimah's position as an international tourism and hospitality destination. The emirate also offers a diverse range of experiences, from the Hajar Mountains and desert landscapes to beaches, marinas, and waterfront promenades. Al Marjan Island benefits from road connectivity to Ras Al Khaimah's key destinations and links to Dubai and other emirates. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport also serves the wider region, supporting access for residents and visitors. With its coastal surroundings, expanding leisure offerings, and resort-oriented atmosphere, Al Marjan Island presents an attractive setting for both lifestyle buyers and investors exploring Ras Al Khaimah's evolving property market. Shoreline brings together contemporary residences and a holiday-inspired living concept in this distinctive waterfront destination.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with a sun deck, a dedicated children's pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, and a welcoming clubhouse. title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. Contact: Mayank

description: Elegant Flats Walking Distance of Metro in Al Jaddaf Dubai Situated at the northern gateway of the Al Jaddaf Waterfront, this high-profile project blends residential, commercial, and retail spaces into one vibrant destination. The strategic position provides an open, airy environment next to Dubai Creek, surrounded by low-rise developments that ensure permanent light and space. The unique dual-profile orientation delivers unblocked vistas in two distinct directions: northwest facing towards Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, and Zabeel, alongside southeast views stretching across Mohammed bin Rashid Library, Dubai Creek Harbour, and the peaceful waterfront. Commuting is completely effortless thanks to the immediate proximity of major transit lines and city landmarks. The Al Jaddaf and Creek Metro stations are just a 2-minute walk away. Key destinations are minutes away by car, including Dubai Healthcare City at 3 minutes, Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa at 5 minutes, and Dubai International Airport within 5 to 10 minutes. Dubai Festival City is 7 minutes away, the Museum of the Future takes 10 minutes, while Jumeirah Beach is a 17-minute drive. The are in a development.The development features an exclusive podium amenity deck packed with over 20 leisure and wellness facilities designed for privacy and family enjoyment. The islands are meticulously designed to provide a serene and exclusive environment, with waterfront promenades that invite leisurely strolls and water sports activities that cater to diverse interests. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: The Wilds Residences is a thoughtfully envisioned residential sanctuary that places nature at the very heart of everyday living. Created by Aldar, the project reimagines modern homes as spaces that restore balance, nurture wellbeing, and foster meaningful connections with the natural world. A curated collection of residences ranges from elegant one-bedroom homes to expansive family duplexes, all designed to blend refined architecture with the calming presence of greenery, water, and open skies. The community is enriched by a remarkable range of nature-led amenities that flow seamlessly through the landscape. Residents enjoy tranquil streams, nature-inspired pools, wellness and spa facilities, fitness zones, yoga decks, creative studios, family lounges, co-working spaces, and immersive outdoor experiences such as birdwatching, stargazing, cycling, and scenic trails. At the heart of the community, landscaped parks, adventure play areas, educational spaces, and social pavilions create a vibrant yet peaceful environment where families and individuals can truly flourish. Interiors are designed to reflect an elegant harmony between refined living and organic inspiration. Homes are bathed in natural light and finished with premium materials, offering a choice of light or dark interior palettes inspired by the natural landscape. Flooring, wall treatments, and bespoke joinery combine durability with warmth, creating interiors that feel grounded, calming, and effortlessly sophisticate. Its setting allows residents to experience a quieter, nature-forward environment while remaining connected to the city's core. The area benefits from convenient access to major road networks, enabling smooth movement across Dubai and easy reach of key business, retail, and leisure destinations. This accessibility supports effortless daily routines while preserving a feeling of separation from dense urban congestion. The surrounding infrastructure continues to evolve, reinforcing the area's appeal as a long-term residential destination. With its emphasis on space, nature, and thoughtful urban planning, Wadi Al Safa 3 offers an environment that supports wellbeing and long-term livability. The district's proximity to green communities, combined with its strategic location within Dubai, makes it an attractive choice for those seeking a lifestyle shaped by calm, connection, and future growth.

Al Jaddaf also benefits from road connectivity and access to public transportation, supporting convenient travel to key business districts, shopping destinations, and entertainment hubs across Dubai. The continued development of residential and hospitality projects is contributing to the area's evolving urban landscape. Combining waterfront appeal, cultural character, and modern infrastructure, Al Jaddaf offers an attractive setting for both homeowners and investors seeking a well-connected Dubai address.

description: Serenz by Danube Properties is an impressive 50-storey residential development designed to redefine contemporary living through an exceptional blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Built around the concept of "A World of Amenities," the development brings together modern architecture, thoughtfully designed residences, and an extensive range of lifestyle facilities to create a vibrant residential experience. The community features a variety of residential options, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, surrounded by parks and green spaces. Residents benefit from access to everyday essentials such as supermarkets, schools, shopping centres, healthcare facilities, and recreational amenities, making the area suitable for families and working professionals alike. JVC also offers convenient connectivity to Dubai's major road networks, allowing residents to reach key commercial, retail, and leisure destinations across the city. Its combination of community facilities, green surroundings, and urban accessibility makes it an attractive choice for both homeowners and property investors. Serenz brings together the advantages of this established community with an extensive collection of lifestyle amenities, fully furnished homes, and contemporary architecture, offering a distinctive approach to modern residential living.

description: Samana Ocean Bay is a contemporary waterfront development that brings together modern architecture, coastal-inspired design, and resort-style living. Inspired by the natural movement of the sea and the openness of the sky, its distinctive curved architecture, luminous façade, and elegant coastal textures create a serene and sophisticated atmosphere. Set within the Dubai Islands destination, Ocean Bay offers a lifestyle shaped by the beauty of the waterfront and the comforts of modern residential living. Amenities and lifestyle Designed around wellness, relaxation, and recreation, Samana Ocean Bay offers a diverse range of lifestyle amenities. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped gym, outdoor fitness areas, meditation zones, a tranquil Zen garden, and a steam room, complemented by landscaped green spaces. The development features an infinity-edge swimming pool, a children's pool, splash areas, and outdoor playgrounds, creating opportunities for relaxation and family-friendly recreation. Together, these facilities deliver a resort-inspired atmosphere where residents can unwind, stay active, and enjoy leisure within their own community. Interiors and finishes Each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximise natural light, space, and comfort. Spacious layouts, high ceilings, and large windows create bright interiors while enhancing the connection between indoor living spaces and the surrounding waterfront setting. Premium materials, carefully selected colour palettes, refined finishes, and ambient lighting contribute to an elegant and welcoming atmosphere. Private infinity pools in the residences, along with spa-inspired bathrooms, add an extra dimension of exclusivity and relaxation. Kitchen and appliances Fully equipped kitchens featuring Bosch appliances, combining modern functionality with everyday convenience. Furnishing Semi-furnished, offering a stylish foundation that residents can personalise to suit their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located on Central Island within Dubai Islands, Samana Ocean Bay is part of a distinctive waterfront destination designed to combine coastal living with contemporary urban convenience. The wider development comprises five islands, with plans for residential communities, beachfront experiences, hospitality venues, retail destinations, and leisure facilities. The island setting offers a more relaxed atmosphere, with access to beaches, landscaped spaces, and waterfront activities. Road connections to mainland Dubai provide access to the city's established business districts, shopping destinations, and entertainment hubs, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. With its coastal surroundings, resort-inspired amenities, and contemporary residences, Samana Ocean Bay offers an appealing choice for buyers seeking a waterfront lifestyle that balances tranquillity, modern comfort, and access to Dubai's wider attractions.

Legado by Prescott is a residential tower by Prescott in JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle). Circle Mall is about 10 minutes away, and Hessa Street, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are all close by.

The project suits buyers looking for a family-oriented tower in JVC with a broad set of shared facilities. Prescott has been active in Dubai since 2006 and has delivered projects such as Prime Residency and Prime Views. title: Ras Al Khor, Dubai
description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. description: Apartments in a Luxury Complex with Rich Social Facilities in Abu Dhabi Yas Island The apartments are in a comprehensive complex in Abu Dhabi, Yas Island. Built on a 10,000 sqm land area, the complex offers the opportunity to discover the lush community park's magnificent blend of luxury and natural aesthetic lifestyle. The complex offers spectacular views of the park and easy access to other leisure and wellness facilities. The are 2 minutes from Yas Acres Golf Club, 7 minutes from IKEA, 9 minutes from Ferrari World, 10 minutes from Warner Brothers World, 10 minutes from Yas Beach, 25 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport, and a 60-minute drive from Downtown Dubai. The complex offers a healthy lifestyle and privacy-oriented, tranquil, and comfortable facilities in its lush green environment. The project comprises 3 blocks with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, duplexes, garden apartments and penthouses. Each apartment is equipped with sustainable, smart, and convenient features. The apartments come with kitchens curated by renowned Chef Izu. Woods Bagot, Mustard, and Flax are the key features of the apartments, which together create an enchanting concept of interiors. The apartments for sale have charming facades with lavish architectural craftsmanship and meticulously placed windows and balconies. This avant-garde development aims to hold the Estidama 3 Pearl rating benchmark, Fitwel, and LEED Gold Certification. Cutting-edge sustainable features, functional design, and water, waste, and energy-efficient options are the elements that promote a sustainable, thriving, and healthy lifestyle. Located in the most vibrant spot on the island, the apartments offer quick and hassle-free access to the community's many famous attractions. The project has a boutique spa, retail spaces, 24/7 concierge services, a lounge, a multipurpose room, a theater room, recreational and fitness areas, a gym, a cycling path, outdoor work pods, co-working spaces, a library, and a children's playground. There is also a car charging station within the complex. Each apartment has an open-plan kitchen combining dining and living areas, bedrooms with private bathrooms, luxurious bathrooms, and balconies offering superb views. In the duplex apartments, the bedrooms are situated on the upper floor. Each apartment has a custom-designed kitchen with remarkable details. These Yas Island apartments with installment payments combine modern design and comfort to suit your lifestyle.
